description: Local overrides layered on top of the org-inherited Renovate config: group non-major updates per ecosystem to stop the per-manifest PR pileup, and automerge the safe tiers once CI is green. Major and pre-1.0 (0.x) updates stay separate for manual review.

packageRules.description: Group Go non-major updates into one PR (all share go/.../services/go.mod+go.sum).
Group Python non-major updates into one PR.
Group Java/Maven non-major updates into one PR.
Group Ruby/Bundler non-major updates into one PR.
Group Node.js/npm non-major updates into one PR.
Group container base-image non-major updates into one PR.

Automerge the safe tiers (minor/patch/digest/pin) once branch checks pass — covers security patch/minor too. 0.x deps are pulled into a separate manual group by the rule below (applied after this one), so a single 0.x dep no longer blocks automerge of an ecosystem's non-0.x group. Requires the branch-protection ruleset to allow the Renovate app to bypass required review (see PR description).

Split pre-1.0 (0.x) non-major updates into their own per-ecosystem group and require manual review. SemVer permits breaking changes in 0.x minor releases (Renovate warns about this), and this repo has many 0.x deps (e.g. OpenTelemetry packages); a separate group lets the non-0.x members of each ecosystem still automerge via the rule above. Uses the plain /^0/ matcher (not a negated one) for broad Renovate-version compatibility.
Never automerge major updates; keep them separate and flag for manual review (potential breaking changes).

Cap setuptools below v82. This repo pins setuptools only to provide pkg_resources for opentelemetry-instrumentation (python:3.12-slim no longer bundles it); setuptools removed pkg_resources in v82, so any >=82 bump breaks the Python services at import time (see closed PR #23). Remove this cap if the otel bootstrap migrates off pkg_resources to importlib.metadata.
